about: What music, previewNote and single voices sounded like before cues touched the engine: the references existingBehaviour.render.test.ts holds them to. Only a change meant to be heard moves one, and each such move is listed under moved, file by file, oldest first: what changed, how it was recorded, and by how much.
platform: darwin arm64, Node v24.21.0: where all six were reproduced and transport-composition.wav was recorded again
how: First recorded in #105, before any engine change, by existingBehaviour.render.test.ts with UPDATE_RENDER_REFERENCE=1. 209a28d, main as #105 found it, reproduces all six byte for byte when that test and renderHarness.ts, as #110 has them, are run against it.

transport-composition.wav.patch: EffectsChain.makeDistortionCurve as #110 has it: 44101 points at x = 2i/(n - 1) - 1, where 209a28d has 44100 at x = 2i/n - 1. Nothing else.
transport-composition.wav.how: At 209a28d with the patch applied, run as above. With the patch the other five render byte for byte as before, so they were left alone.
transport-composition.wav.why: Re-recorded for #110. The composition's bass and lead play through track chains with distortion 0.1 and 0.05. Their waveshapers read a curve centred half a point off, so with nothing going in they put out an offset, which reached the output through the mixer, the master gain and the compressor as -5.0935e-4, about -65.9 dBFS, before a note played, and stayed under the music. Centring the curve takes the offset away, and moves each distorted note by the same half step along the curve.
transport-composition.wav.by: +5.0935e-4 before the music starts. The largest difference once it plays is that same offset, at the first note, and the largest anywhere is 5.5466e-4, while the oversamplers settle. The difference is 61 dB below the composition by RMS: -72.0 dBFS against -11.0.

transport-composition.wav.change: A held song note holds until its release (the songs-play-the-same branch, after ef0c8ed)
transport-composition.wav.patch: VoiceSynthesizer.noteOff ends the envelope at the level it has at the release, computed from the envelope the voice scheduled, in every renderer. It no longer calls cancelAndHoldAtTime, which after the last scheduled event inserts nothing, so the release ramp started from the decay's end. Nothing else.
transport-composition.wav.how: Recorded on the commit before the change, ef0c8ed, with only the change applied. ef0c8ed first rendered all six references byte for byte with UPDATE_RENDER_REFERENCE=1. The two voices with no release, voice-sine.wav and voice-velocity-zero.wav, came out byte for byte with the change too, and were left alone.
transport-composition.wav.why: In this renderer, as in Chromium and WebKit, a note released after its decay faded from the decay's end through its hold. Each of these four releases a note after its decay ends.
transport-composition.wav.by: From 0.2860 s, as notes held past their decay hold instead of fading. The largest difference is 0.27268, at 2.7075 s; the difference is 14.6 dB below the composition by RMS: -25.6 dBFS against -11.0.

transport-composition.wav.change: The reverb is seeded from each track's id (the songs-play-the-same branch, after 662b7ef)
transport-composition.wav.patch: EffectsChain draws its impulse response from reverbImpulse.ts: mulberry32 seeded with FNV-1a over the UTF-8 bytes of the track's id, faded by (1 - t) * (1 - t), where it drew from Math.random. The test had seeded Math.random to make the draw repeat; it no longer needs to, and does not. Nothing else.
transport-composition.wav.how: Recorded on the commit before the change, 662b7ef, with only the change applied. 662b7ef first rendered all six references byte for byte with UPDATE_RENDER_REFERENCE=1. The other five came out byte for byte with the change too: none of them builds a track's chain. Recorded twice, byte for byte alike.
transport-composition.wav.why: The composition's pad sends to the reverb, at 0.35, so its echo is now the pad track's own draw, the same on every load, where it was the draw seedRandom gave it.
transport-composition.wav.by: From 0.1360 s, as the pad's reverb begins. The largest difference is 0.081619, at 3.0401 s; the difference is 21.2 dB below the composition by RMS: -31.8 dBFS against -10.6.
